data.exact_reserve_text: The syndicate released prior year reserves of $4.6m during 2014 (2013: strengthening of $3.6m).

prior_year_events.event_name: Life, accident and health loss activity
prior_year_events.impact_description: Significant loss activity in 2013 in the life, accident and health division affected claims experience and subsequent reserve movements

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2014 were 265.0 (USD m). The syndicate recorded a prior-year release of 4.6 (USD m) in 2014 (reported as a release), driven principally by favourable claims development following significant loss activity in the life, accident and health division in 2013. No gross prior-year movement figure (insurance-liabilities column) was explicitly provided, so the reported net release from the Managing Agent was used as the best available quantification.
raw_causal_phrases: The syndicate released prior year reserves of $4.6m during 2014 (2013: strengthening of $3.6m).
Following the significant loss activity experienced in our life, accident and health division in 2013, the syndicate's overall claims ratio decreased from 61% in the prior year to 56% in 2014.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, liabilities, prior-year comparative column). No explicit GROSS 'movement in prior years provision for claims outstanding' was found; the Managing Agent's narrative sentence reporting a $4.6m release was used as a net prior-year movement (NET of reinsurance) as a last-resort fallback. Amounts are reported in the native currency of the statements (USD).
